Title: Changes in the rulebook. Is there a summary?

Messages.Author: Marlo - The Iceman
Messages.Body:
Hi folks,

Is there some place where I can find a summary of the changes made in
the rulebook, from LoB to Third? Due to distribution problems most
brazilians (like me) couldn't yet buy precon decks, so we have to use
the online version.

[]s

Marlo

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The online version is the Third Ed version.

Changes:
Draft effects (1.6.1.6)
OOT Trifles (1.6.2.5)
Regent title references (6.3.3 and 10.2)

Non-material stuff, like acknowledging non-vampire crypt cards, and
tweaks to section 10.
